findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are hard-coded in plaintext as Lambda environment variables, exposing long-lived IAM credentials in Terraform state, source control, and to anyone with read access to the function configuration.

The environment variables block does not specify a customer-managed KMS key (kms_key_arn), so the embedded sensitive values rely only on default AWS-managed encryption, providing weaker key management and audit control for this sensitive data.
The function uses nodejs12.x, an end-of-life Node.js runtime that no longer receives security patches, increasing exposure to unpatched vulnerabilities.
